title: Time Expressions — Daily Schedule
grammarPoint: Time adverbs: rano, wieczorem, zawsze, często, rzadko, nigdy; days of the week

explanation.text:
Polish has a rich set of time expressions for talking about daily routine. Here are the most essential ones:

**Frequency adverbs** (how often):

| Polish | English |
|--------|--------|
| zawsze | always |
| często | often |
| zwykle | usually |
| czasem / czasami | sometimes |
| rzadko | rarely |
| nigdy (nie) | never |

**Time of day:**

| Polish | English |
|--------|--------|
| rano | in the morning |
| po południu | in the afternoon |
| wieczorem | in the evening |
| w nocy | at night |
| w południe | at noon |
| w nocy | at night |

**Days of the week** (w + day — no capital):

| Polish | English |
|--------|--------|
| w poniedziałek | on Monday |
| we wtorek | on Tuesday |
| w środę | on Wednesday |
| w czwartek | on Thursday |
| w piątek | on Friday |
| w sobotę | on Saturday |
| w niedzielę | on Sunday |

**Word order tip:** Frequency adverbs usually come before the verb: *Zawsze czytam rano.* = I always read in the morning.
notes: nigdy requires double negation: Nigdy nie idę tam. = I never go there.
Days of the week in Polish are lowercase and masculine (mostly): poniedziałek, wtorek, środa (f), czwartek, piątek, sobota (f), niedziela (f).
'W' + accusative for days: w poniedziałek, we wtorek (we before wt-), w środę (acc of środa).
rano = adverb (no preposition); wieczorem = instrumental of wieczór used as adverb.

exercises.prompt: Idę do pracy ___ piątek. (I go to work on Friday.)
exercises.hint: Days of the week take 'w' + accusative in Polish

exercises.explanation: You heard: 'Nigdy nie piję kawy wieczorem.' — I never drink coffee in the evening. 'Nigdy nie' = never (double negation). 'Wieczorem' = in the evening.

exercises.prompt: Build: I usually read in the morning.
exercises.explanation: 'Zwykle czytam rano' = I usually read in the morning. 'Zwykle' = usually (frequency adverb before verb). 'Rano' = in the morning.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'on Wednesday' in Polish?
exercises.explanation: 'W środę' = on Wednesday. 'Środa' (f) → accusative 'środę'. Use 'w' (not 'we') before środa.
